races.name: Dragonborn
races.description: Born of dragons, Dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension.

races.name: Hill Dwarf
races.description: As a hill dwarf, you have keen senses, deep intuition, and remarkable resilience.

races.name: Mountain Dwarf
races.description: As a mountain dwarf, you're strong and hardy, accustomed to a difficult life in rugged terrain.

races.name: High Elf
races.description: High elves have a keen mind and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.

races.name: Wood Elf
races.description: Wood elves have keen senses and intuition, and their fleet feet carry them quickly through their native forests.

races.name: Forest Gnome
races.description: Forest gnomes have a natural knack for illusion and inherent quickness and stealth.

races.name: Rock Gnome
races.description: Rock gnomes have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes.

races.name: Lightfoot Halfling
races.description: As a lightfoot halfling, you can easily hide from notice, even using other people as cover.

races.name: Stout Halfling
races.description: As a stout halfling, you're hardier than average and have some resistance to poison.

races.name: Human
races.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their elf and human parents.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.description: Half-orcs inherit a tendency toward chaos from their orc parents and are not strongly inclined toward good.

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Tieflings are derived from human bloodlines, and in the broadest possible sense, they still look human.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A fierce warrior who can enter a battle rage.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of spells.
